newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Remain lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Remain lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained thinly quoted on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. There were no trades versus none on Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 105 percent of tariff, no comparison, offer 110 percent.
- Nine barges, one each week May and June, Mississippi River (St. Paul through Savage) bid 2-1/2 points lower at 145 percent from Tuesday, no offer, unchanged.
- Nine barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week June and July, no bid, offered at 125 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday.
